rows.capability: WFDB source ingestion and calibrated waveform reading
rows.reason: Target has governed WFDB byte/header/calibration handling hardened by DONOR-001 with strict provenance and fail-closed contracts.
Delegates to NeuroKit2; canonical provenance belongs to DONOR-003.
Implementation derives from NeuroKit/Makowski. Preserve OpenECG validation/test methodology, but defer algorithm authority to DONOR-003 and never silently replace target behavior.

rows.capability: QRS width estimator with adaptive threshold relaxation
rows.reason: Potential morphology measurement challenger; contains imputation and heuristic thresholds that require independent validation before any measurement authority.
Strong failure-mode awareness and multiple signal-domain approaches, but thresholds are source/bandwidth dependent and negative results cannot exclude bipolar pacing.
Independent RR-feature challenger is useful for disagreement analysis; hard-coded thresholds were selected on donor cohorts and are not transportable clinical authority.
Target lacks a generic governed challenger-output abstraction spanning waveform boundaries, beat labels and rhythm labels while keeping them source-separated.

rows.capability: Context-margin masking for windowed inference and evaluation
rows.reason: Explicitly excludes context-poor window edges from emitted/evaluated challenger output and supports stitchable streams.
Architecture explicitly records independent-source disagreement and degraded backend state; target can adopt the governance pattern without adopting donor clinical conclusions.

rows.capability: Boundary matching metrics with timing-error distribution
rows.reason: Sensitivity, PPV, F1 and timing error metrics are valuable evaluation methodology; exact matching implementation should be target-owned and verified for one-to-one matching semantics.

rows.capability: Record-level held-out multi-dataset split definitions and layer-specific masked supervision
rows.reason: Strong leakage-control and missing-label discipline; datasets/labels remain source evidence and never project gold.
Useful robustness/evaluation perturbations; donor explicitly avoids horizontal flip/baseline shift and constrains time stretching to reduce morphology corruption.

rows.capability: Structural-prior loss discouraging direct P/QRS/T adjacency and fragmentation
rows.reason: Interesting representation-learning prior, but donor claim is model-specific and should not be embedded into canonical deterministic ECG interpretation without independent label/physiology validation.

rows.capability: TFLite/ONNX lightweight deployment and backend comparison
rows.reason: Strong deployment pattern for isolated future model challengers; no weight is admitted and no inference path becomes target runtime authority.

rows.capability: Bundled boundary and layered-codec trained weights
rows.reason: Separate explicit weight license not established; training-dataset terms also require per-dataset review. Status is LICENSE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, therefore no import.
ECG-FM, ECGFounder and HuBERT-ECG are already scheduled as first-class donors; ST-MEM is queued as an associated donor. Audit originals instead of OpenECG wrappers.

rows.capability: Synthetic ECG and synthetic arrhythmia generation
rows.reason: Potential adversarial/robustness fixture source only; synthetic labels cannot establish clinical validity or diagnostic accuracy.

rows.capability: Structured ECG report intended for agent consumption
rows.reason: As a direct runtime feature it would emit diagnostic/rhythm conclusions and could conflict with the target's GOVERNED_INACTIVE state. Only non-clinical schema/disagreement ideas may be harvested.
